questions.question_text: The Proponent must disclose any litigation or claims against its organization in the last five years that relate to services of this kind.
Who will be the single point of contact for the Division, and what authority do they have to commit your organization?
Provide a profile of your organization, including years in business, number of employees and head office location.
The Proponent must state whether it has an office in Alberta (Yes/No).
Describe at least two comparable projects completed in the last five years, including scope, duration and outcome.
Describe the standard reports and dashboards included, and how custom reports are created.
Describe the licensing model (named user, concurrent or enterprise) and how licence counts are measured.
The student information system must support single sign-on using SAML 2.0 or OpenID Connect (Yes/No).
(Desirable) Describe the parent portal, including how guardians are verified before they can see student records.
Does the student information system produce report cards in the provincial format? (Yes/No)
The Proponent must describe how attendance is captured and how absences are reported to guardians.
The Proponent should describe how data is submitted to the provincial student reporting system.
Please describe how student records are transferred when a student moves to another school division.
The Proponent shall state whether it holds a current ISO/IEC 27001 certification (Yes/No).
How is student records encrypted at rest and in transit, and who holds the encryption keys?
Confirm that monthly availability of at least 99.9 percent will be guaranteed in the service level agreement. (Yes/No)
The Proponent shall describe its disaster recovery plan, including recovery time and recovery point objectives.
Describe how administrative access to production systems is controlled and logged.
Describe how security events are monitored and who responds outside business hours.
State whether penetration testing is performed by an independent party. (Yes/No)
Describe the exit and transition assistance available at the end of the contract.
Identify the five most significant project risks and the mitigation proposed for each.
Describe your testing approach, including user acceptance testing and who signs off.
The Proponent must describe the warranty provided and what it excludes.
Describe your support model, including hours of coverage, escalation paths and target response times.
List all subcontractors you intend to use and the portion of the work each will perform.
Provide a high-level schedule showing the main phases and their durations.
Identify the tasks that need the participation of staff of the Division.
Describe how scope changes will be handled during implementation.
Attach a sample status report from a comparable project.
The Proponent should describe the training provided to administrators and end users, including delivery method, duration and materials.
The Proponent should provide a work plan in tabular form showing milestones, deliverables, responsibilities and dates.
(Optional) Please describe how the student information system scales to support peak loads and growth in the number of users.
The Proponent shall attach a current Workers' Compensation Board clearance letter.
The Proponent shall attach its most recent SOC 2 Type II report.
The Proponent must attach a certificate of insurance showing commercial general liability coverage of not less than $5,000,000.
questions.constraints: commercial general liability of not less than $5,000,000

questions.question_text: Hourly rates by role for change requests and additional services are required.
The Proponent shall state every assumption and exclusion that affects the prices quoted.
Pricing is to be submitted using the Pricing Schedule in Appendix C, in Canadian dollars and excluding GST.
questions.constraints: Appendix C; Canadian dollars, excluding GST

questions.question_text: Any annual price escalation proposed for the term of the contract is to be described.
The student information system should provide a mobile application for iOS and Android.
The student information system shall allow authorized users to export any report to Excel and PDF.
The student information system shall provide an administrator dashboard showing system health and usage.
The student information system shall provide a documented REST API covering every function available in the user interface.
The student information system shall provide a test environment for trying upgrades before they reach production.
The student information system should offer a French-language user interface.
The Proponent shall describe its disaster recovery plan, including recovery time and recovery point objectives.
(Optional) Describe the training provided to administrators and end users, including delivery method, duration and materials.
The Proponent shall describe the security controls that protect student records at rest and in transit.
